<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/revert_workflow_change/{project_guid}/{workflow_guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Undoes one change from get_workflow_history by committing its reverse on
the project hub - a deleted node comes back with its files, settings and
connections; an added node or connection goes again. Then propagates to every clone and
reloads the project in the runtime, as a canvas save does.
